<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For a nonempty family of processes, pooling steps preserves exactly the union of finite endpoint histories iff that union is closed under joining. Retaining context realizes the union exactly; a joint context-changing relation derives successor support from the same incoming history.

Canonical source: [Context.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Common state and event interpretations, a nonempty process family for the pooling equivalence, finite inductive Trace and actual boundary matching.
- The evolving construction supplies a joint relation on context and displayed conditions. Logical framework and correspondence remain explicit; no normative, totality or favorable-direction premise.

Context denotes consequential relations within one unfolding, not an independently constituted controller. Semantic support need not be an implemented observer belief.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Fresh Lean 4.29.1: 20 new theorems / 30 new declaration audits plus 28 inherited audits. 57/58 reports empty; terminality uses propext. No custom postulates, classical choice, independent-agent acceptance or new empirical evidence.

Finite conditional coherence, not universal actual law, physical mechanism, infinite-path coverage, ethical warrant or zero-substantive-axiom grounding. The lifting criterion has a stronger specified-initial-context scope than family-union exactness. Existential context support is not quantum control coherence; no operational correspondence to the switch comparison is proved.

- Pooling 0→1 and 1→2 from incompatible contexts admits an unsupported whole history. A separately declared actual context change supports a coherent history which terminates.
